notes: Same as droso_coleoptera_w1_seeds_dropout0.json (1 kb window, 500 bp stride, micro_batch 80 x grad_accum 1, bf16, dropout 0) but with a fixed 15-epoch budget, no early stopping, and the cosine schedule spanning those 15 epochs (lr 3e-4 -> 3e-5 floor). With early stopping on a 30-epoch cosine, runs stopped at epochs 7-16 with lr still 2.3-3.0e-4 and end-of-epoch weights fluctuated (training-set loss of the epoch-end weights jumped together with validation loss). The final-epoch checkpoint (last_model.pt) is the primary model, so 3L reference labels are not used for checkpoint selection; best_model.pt is evaluated for comparison.
